events.text: Vasudeva Nanayakkara was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: born 3 January 1939

events.text: Nanayakkara joined the Lanka Sama Samaja Party (LSSP) as student.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Nanayakkara joined the Lanka Sama Samaja Party ( LSSP ) as student in 1958 .

events.text: Nanayakkara was elected to parliament, representing Kiriella for the LSSP.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was elected to parliament at the 1970 parliamentary election , representing Kiriella for the LSSP .

events.text: Nanayakkara joined with other former members of the LSSP to form the Nava Sama Samaja Party (NSSP).
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1977 joined with other former members of the LSSP , including Vikramabahu Karunaratne , to form the Nava Sama Samaja Party ( NSSP )

events.text: Nanayakkara was the NSSP's candidate in Ehaliyagoda at the parliamentary election but failed to get elected.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was the NSSPs candidate in Ehaliyagoda at 1977 parliamentary election but failed to get elected .

events.text: Nanayakkara was the NSSP's candidate at the presidential election, coming fifth and last.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was the NSSPs candidate at the 1982 presidential election . He came fifth and last

events.text: Nanayakkara went into hiding until the proscription was lifted.
events.subject: self
events.quote: after the Black July anti-Tamil riots of 1983 . Nanayakkara , Karunaratne , Rohana Wijeweera and other left-wing politicians went into hiding

events.text: Nanayakkara's hiding ended when the proscription was lifted.
events.subject: self
events.quote: went into hiding until 1985 when the proscription was lifted

events.text: The NSSP joined with the LSSP, CP and Sri Lanka Peoples Party to form the United Socialist Alliance (USA).
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In 1987 the NSSP joined with the LSSP , CP and Sri Lanka Peoples Party to form the United Socialist Alliance ( USA ) .

events.text: Nanayakkara re-entered parliament, representing Ratnapura District for the USA.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Nanayakkara re-entered parliament after the 1989 parliamentary election , representing Ratnapura District for the USA .

events.text: Nanayakkara left the NSSP and rejoined the LSSP.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Shortly before the 1994 parliamentary election Nanayakkara left the NSSP and rejoined the LSSP

events.text: Nanayakkara was elected as one of the PA's parliamentary candidates for Ratnapura District.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was chosen as one of the PAs parliamentary candidates for Ratnapura District and duly elected .

events.text: Nanayakkara was suspended from the LSSP.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was suspended from the LSSP in April 1999 .

events.text: Nanayakkara crossed over to the opposition in parliament.
events.subject: self
events.quote: A few days later Nanayakkara crossed over to the opposition in parliament .

events.text: Nanayakkara stood as the Left & Democratic Alliance's candidate against President Kumaratunga at the presidential election, coming seventh.
events.subject: self
events.quote: stood as its candidate , against President Kumaratunga , at the 1999 presidential election . He came seventh

events.text: Nanayakkara was chosen as the UPFA's mayoral candidate for Colombo at the local government elections.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Nanayakkara was chosen as the UPFAs mayoral candidate for Colombo at the 2006 local government elections .

events.text: Nanayakkara was elected to the Colombo Municipal Council.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was elected to the Colombo Municipal Council but the UPFA failed to gain control of the council .

events.text: Nanayakkara was chosen as one of the UPFA's parliamentary candidates for Ratnapura District.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Nanayakkara was chosen as one of the UPFAs parliamentary candidates for Ratnapura District at the 2010 parliamentary election .

events.text: Nanayakkara was duly elected.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was duly elected .

events.text: Vasudeva used profane language again.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Again in 2017 Vasudeva used profane language
